Overrode a swarm worker that cured the inbox invisibility by widening no-seat reads to return every row. That reinstates exactly what migrations/0120_targeted_seat_messages.sql exists to prevent — an un-scoped reader draining a live sibling seat's mail — trading silent invisibility for silent misdelivery.
